facts.fact: 2026 regular season is 18 weeks, 272 games; each of 32 teams plays 17 regular-season games plus 3 preseason games (sixth consecutive year).
Season kicks off Wednesday, September 9, 2026: defending Super Bowl LX champion Seattle Seahawks host New England Patriots at Lumen Field, 8:20 p.m. ET, NBC (Super Bowl LX rematch).
Week 1 also features Rams vs 49ers on Thursday, September 10, 8:35 p.m. ET, Netflix, at Melbourne Cricket Ground - first-ever regular-season NFL game in Australia.
Season concludes Week 18 with 16 division games: three on Saturday, January 9, 2027 and 13 on Sunday, January 10, 2027 (17th consecutive year all Week 18 games are division contests).

Nine international games (most ever): Melbourne (W1), Rio de Janeiro Maracana (W3), London Tottenham (W4, W5), London Wembley (W6), Paris Stade de France (W7), Madrid Bernabeu (W9), Munich (W10), Mexico City Estadio Banorte (W11).
Thanksgiving (Thursday, November 26, 2026) tripleheader: Bears at Lions 1 p.m. ET CBS; Eagles at Cowboys 4:30 p.m. ET FOX; Chiefs at Bills 8:20 p.m. ET NBC.

Playoffs: 14 teams (7 per conference) since 2020; No. 1 seed in each conference has a bye; Wild Card games: 2 hosts 7, 3 hosts 6, 4 hosts 5. Wild Card Weekend begins Saturday, January 16, 2027 (6 games, powered by Verizon); Divisional Playoffs January 23-24; Championship Games Sunday, January 31; Super Bowl LXI Sunday, February 14, 2027 at SoFi Stadium, Los Angeles (ESPN).

Thursday Night Football airs exclusively on Prime Video, 15 games Weeks 2-17 (excluding Thanksgiving); Netflix streams the Thanksgiving Eve game (Packers at Rams, Wed Nov 25, Week 12) and two Christmas Day games (Week 16).

rulebook_source.note: Official 2026 NFL Rulebook. 2026 rule changes: 6-1-3 (kickoff setup zone alignment), 6-1-5 (dead ball spot after touchback from 50), 6-1-6 (onside kick declarable at any time), 19-2 (league personnel consultation on disqualification).
